input_language.description: Input language for interpreting date/event specifications in this file (e.g., en, de, fr).

output_language.description: Output language for month/day names on the calendar (e.g., en, de, fr).

paper_size.description: Paper size option (-P). Supported: letter, legal, a4, tabloid.

first_day_of_week.description: First day of the week option (-F). Name (mon, tue...) or number (0-6).

title.description: Footer string (-L) to print as left-justified footer/title text.

notes_heading.description: Notes box heading (-N). Leave empty to suppress notes box heading.

use_american_dates.description: Use American date formats (-A) if true, European (-E) if false.

events.description: List of event entries to be placed on the calendar. Each item has a date_spec and text.

events_items.description: Schema for items in the events list.

notes.description: List of note entries. Each item has text and an optional box_number.

notes_items.description: Schema for items in the notes list.
